description: This file contains test cases for configuration mutation helper functions, specifically testing config file mutation, conflict detection, and snapshot reading. It uses the 'vitest' testing framework.

methods.name: readSourceConfigSnapshot
methods.description: Reads a snapshot of the source configuration, returning a hash and other snapshot data.

methods.name: mutateConfigFile
methods.description: Mutates the configuration file with optimistic hash protection, applying changes through a draft function.

methods.name: replaceConfigFile
methods.description: Replaces the configuration file if the base hash matches, otherwise throws a conflict error.

methods.name: withTempHome
methods.description: Sets up a temporary home directory environment for testing purposes.
